data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Concrete deferred-park alt-closure mechanics — if draft-9 (26de) is not closed when task-4 is ready: (a) task-4 closed with tag deferred:draft-9-pending, (b) follow-up ticket created with relation blocks → 26de, (c) follow-up description includes the exact 6-case matrix spec verbatim, (d) story closure records dd-3 as DEFERRED with pointer to follow-up ticket (must NOT claim dd-3 coverage on the deferred path). Without these mechanics, deferred-park is interpretable as silent skip OR unscheduled obligation — both break closure discipline (cross_task_interference).
